design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (hospital_account_billing, env_0073). Frozen 2026-10-16 10:42:00 CDT. Rework rounds 2-7 (audit revision_1 C1..C9, revision_2 C1', C2', C3', C10-C15, render round 1 Mismatch 1, Notes 2-3, revision_4 C16, KB audit src-1/src-2, and KB cross-product seed items src-3/src-4/src-5 closed; see worklog).

1. WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST. Lorraine Dvorak asks only to pay her August 24 imaging account off in full today. The payoff rule (encounter_ext_insured_payoff) carries the prerequisite sentence "On an account that carries a non-covered-service liability posting and whose patient class grants the uninsured discount on such postings, the insured payoff amount is fixed only after an uninsured discount stands against one of those postings." The ledger shows a NONCOVERED_SERVICE posting of 418.00 (the payer's PR-204 release for the calcium-score CT) that no UNINSURED_DISCOUNT names, on a Diagnostic-tier account whose variant grants the discount on insured non-covered services. A solver must find that state, price the discount under encounter_ext_noncovered_discount (six factors), post it, and only then price the payoff (six factors) on the lowered balance. Skipping the discount gives payoff 1196.09 instead of 915.89.

2. SCOPE SNAPSHOT. Draw: {"task": 0, "prerequisite_problems": 1, "factor_counts": [6, 6]}; task 1 draws prerequisite_problems 3, factor_counts [5, 4, 4, 6]. Task 0 claims encounter_ext_noncovered_discount + encounter_ext_insured_payoff and tools post_noncovered_line_discount_93cdc726 (agent) + pay_insured_balance_in_full_a10a8aeb (user). Disjoint from task 1 (terminated-coverage discount, observation-rate discount, service-recovery courtesy, self-pay payoff).

3. PROBLEM TREE CARD.
 Root encounter_ext_insured_payoff (on_request; subject payment_posted/adjustment_posted/closed; computes amount; user tool).
 Edge root -> encounter_ext_noncovered_discount: kind value_input, gate ins_balance, form state. Sentence and condition name the same waited-on state (C1/C9/C2'): an UNINSURED_DISCOUNT stands against one of the account's NONCOVERED_SERVICE postings, on a patient class whose variant grants that discount. The depended-on rule prices the account's total non-covered amount in ONE adjustment sourced to the most recent posting (first recorded on a same-day tie) and says a posting recorded after it receives no further discount, so the wait, once met, stays met (always satisfiable; no "every/for each" claim). The figure is positive whenever the wait applies (non-covered amount above 0.00, starting percent above 0), so C1' (0.00 write) cannot arise. Round 6 (src-1): the sentence now states the scope its condition carries, an account that carries a non-covered-service liability posting and whose patient class grants the discount; an insured account without such a posting is outside the wait, in the words as in the condition.
 Unresolved at frozen_time: initial_state.encounter_transactions.<a0_nc> liability_source NONCOVERED_SERVICE 418.00; no encounter_adjustment_posted row names it; Diagnostic tier (uninsured_discount_on_noncovered_insured true). Under its own declared condition the state is false at opening.
 Uniqueness of the resolving write: UNINSURED_DISCOUNT rows sourced to a NONCOVERED_SERVICE posting are written only by encounter_ext_noncovered_discount (the other UNINSURED_DISCOUNT writers source COVERAGE_TERMINATED postings or 0762 charge lines).
 Topological order: noncovered discount (step 11) then payoff (step 13). Deletion: skipping step 11 gives payoff 1196.09 instead of 915.89.
 Customer write: the payoff payment (owner=user) from her own checking account.
 no_user_hint: the persona never mentions a discount on the scan or any posting; tools validate nothing (section 9).

4. FACTOR CARD — encounter_ext_noncovered_discount (baseline: uninsured_discount_pct 55.0 of the account's NONCOVERED_SERVICE total 418.00 = 229.90; result 340.67 = MN(418.00, RND(418.00 x 81.5 / 100, 2))). Realism: Riverbend's own uninsured-discount schedule extended to insured non-covered services (patient class and variant flag), the federal FAP figures only where the assistance case is read.
 noncovered_size_band (parameter): 418.00 at least mid_band_usd 250, below large_band_usd 1000 -> +5.0; this factor at baseline gives 319.77.
 site_of_service (parameter, multi-source: facility AND CT/MRI revenue lines): Grand Chute freestanding center with 0350 and 0610 lines -> +5.0; 319.77.
 deductible_burden (method): DEDUCTIBLE 1150.00 at least deductible_high_usd 1000 -> int(1150 / 250) = 4 points (cap 6); 323.95.
 estimate_surprise (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty estimate): Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate linked to the account, current version 2 furnished 2026-08-24, on its 2026-08-24 service date (the day-of-service revision adding the calcium score), non-covered 418.00 above 15% of 1026.00 = 153.90 -> +5.0; 319.77. Absent date (C3): an estimate with no scheduled_service_date falls to the late tier (+2.5), stated in the rule and probed; that tier no longer carries the scope-restating conjunct "non-covered amount above 0.00" (C11).
 near_eligibility (parameter, cross-difficulty assist): the patient's most recent assistance determination (only cases in approved, denied, expired or revoked status are determinations (a submitted, pending_documents or withdrawn case is never read, whatever its date; Note 3), latest determination_date, an award dated the same day as a denial counts as later, first recorded of two same-day denials; C10) is the Medical Hardship tier denial INCOME_ABOVE_LIMIT of 2026-01-20, 269 days before (within near_window_days 365) -> +5.0; 319.77. Real figures in the seeded case: 2025 HHS poverty guideline, household 2 $21,150; income 95,175.00 = 450% FPL.
 covered_visit_addon (parameter): MEDICALLY_NECESSARY visit with covered cost-sharing 1196.00 -> +2.5; 330.22.
 Independence (XF A1, mechanical sweep): no factor binding reads another factor's binding, transitively; the non-covered total is a plain binding stated once.
 Method all-pairs table (deductible_burden): proportional vs flat — proportional adds the deductible as an input (1000 -> 4, 1500 -> 6 capped; flat 1.5 stays); proportional vs none — none is 0 below 500 while proportional is at least 4 on its whole domain; flat vs none — flat 1.5 on [500, 1000), none 0 below 500. Every pair has a distinguishing input; no pair is the same combination of the same sums.

5. FACTOR CARD — encounter_ext_insured_payoff (baseline: balance 1123.33 after the discount less prompt_pay_discount_pct 10.0 = 1011.00; result 915.89 = MX(0, 1123.33 - RND(1123.33 x 17.75 / 100, 2) - 8.05)).
 days_to_pay_schedule (parameter, date): 7 days after first statement 2026-10-09, within first_window_days 10 -> +4.0; 960.82.
 paperless_allowance (parameter): latest SUMMARY_STATEMENT (first recorded on a same-day tie) by PATIENT_PORTAL -> +1.0; 927.12.
 liability_size_band (parameter): liabilities 1614.00 at least 1000, below 2500 -> +1.0; 927.12.
 estimate_variance_relief (method, multi-source, cross-difficulty estimate): cost-sharing 1196.00 above tolerance 1026.00 x 1.15 = 1179.90 (current version 2), furnished on its service date -> RND((1196.00 - 1179.90) x 0.5, 2) = 8.05; 923.94. Absent date (C3a): no scheduled_service_date -> late tier flat 25.00 (probed 898.94); no estimate -> no credit (probed 923.94).
 check_in_payment_allowance (parameter): POINT_OF_SERVICE 150.00 below pos_full_usd 250 -> +0.75; 924.31.
 noncovered_share (parameter): 418.00 / 1614.00 = 25.9% (at least 20, below 50) -> +1.0; 927.12.
 Method all-pairs table (estimate_variance_relief): proportional vs flat — proportional reads cost-sharing and tolerance (excess 16.10 -> 8.05, excess 200 -> 100.00; flat 25.00 stays); proportional vs none — proportional is positive on its whole domain (excess > 0); flat vs none — flat 25.00 vs 0.
 Every factor's tier rests on seeded rows; the whole baseline 1011.00 != 915.89.

6. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Writes of subject encounter_adjustment_posted (step 11) and payment_posted/adjustment_posted/closed (step 13) inherit: encounter_prompt_pay_discount.prompt_window (time: anchor encounter_accounts.first_statement_date 2026-10-09, +30 calendar days counted from the day after, inclusive, not_after; frozen 2026-10-16 is day 7; 2026-11-08 last qualifying, 2026-11-09 fails), one_prompt_discount (no PROMPT_PAY_DISCOUNT on the account), small_balance_and_courtesy.courtesy_once_per_year (no courtesy in 2026), policy_scope for charge_dispute, coverage_update_rebill, agg_payment_application, final_bill_and_liability. Prompt-pay conditions in force: balance 1123.33 at least prompt_pay_min_balance_usd; ACH_BANK_DRAFT an eligible channel; no FAP_CHARITY_ADJUSTMENT; no payment plan.
 Overwrites (C4/XF D): encounter_ext_noncovered_discount retires (a) the base sentence giving a NONCOVERED_SERVICE line "the same uninsured_discount_pct" (this rule fixes a different amount; replaced_by keeps the tier flag and the exclusion of deductible, coinsurance and copay) and (b) the SELF_PAY-at-final-bill gate (replaced_by restates the SELF_PAY case and names both sibling cases — corrected-to-SELF_PAY COVERAGE_TERMINATED postings and the observation-rate discount — as outside). encounter_ext_insured_payoff retires the prompt-pay amount sentence for non-SELF_PAY accounts only, restating that the discount posts as PROMPT_PAY_DISCOUNT sourced to the qualifying payment; the SELF_PAY sibling (encounter_ext_selfpay_payoff) excludes this case by name and vice versa. Rounding half-up stays in force (base clause not retired).

7. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target: hospital account A0 (Outpatient Diagnostic Imaging & Lab Account, Grand Chute, 2026-08-24). Discount source: the account's most recent (and only) NONCOVERED_SERVICE posting of claim C0 (418.00). Included rows: charge lines 2640.00 MRI 0610 and 418.00 CT calcium score 0350, POS payment 150.00, DEDUCTIBLE 1150.00, COINSURANCE 46.00, NONCOVERED 418.00, SUMMARY cycle 1 by PATIENT_PORTAL. Excluded: the closed 2025 clinic account A1 (COPAY 40.00 posted 2025-12-09, summary 2025-12-15, paid PORTAL_CARD 2026-02-10 after the January assistance denial; balance 0.00). Claim C0: billed 3058. Claim C0 was first submitted 2026-08-28 under the 2025 member ID, rejected at the front end (277CA, INVALID_MEMBER_ID), corrected from the card and resubmitted 2026-09-02 (claim_correction_filed MEMBER_ID_CORRECTED; frequency code stays 1 because a rejected claim was never accepted, so the resubmission is not a replacement). Round 7 (src-5).00, payment 184.00, CO-45 1260.00, PR-1 1150.00, PR-2 46.00, PR-204 418.00, payer_balance 0.00. Estimate E0: Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate for 72148, version 1 issued 2026-08-13 (MRI line 996.00 = remaining deductible 900.00 verified under the member ID then on file + 20% of the rest); the calcium score was ordered the morning of service, so version 2 was furnished 2026-08-24 (MRI 996.00 + CT 75571 30.00, the CT expected at 20% coinsurance on the benefits verified that day), total 1026.00; the payer later released the CT as non-covered (PR-204, waiver signed at check-in) and applied 1150.00 deductible under the corrected member ID. Round 7 (src-4). Assistance case L1: Medical Hardship tier (above 400% FPL), application 2026-01-06, household 2, income 95175.00 (450% of the 2025 guideline 21,150), qualifying medical debt 1040.00, liquid assets 18750.00 (within the 25000.00 hardship asset limit, so only "income above limit" applies; round 7, src-3), denied INCOME_ABOVE_LIMIT 2026-01-20 (hardship debt below 20% of income); four ACCEPTED documents and a DENIAL_LETTER.

8. PERSONA. Brisk office manager; volunteers only the goal and her name; DOB and ZIP on request (MRN, phone, SSN-4 as alternates); knows $1,464.00 and the prompt-pay line from her portal statement; says when asked that her January assistance application was turned down; passive: "go ahead" if told something must be posted first; pays the quoted amount by bank draft when handed the tool; ends after confirmation.

9. TOOLS DO NOT BLOCK. post_noncovered_line_discount_93cdc726 books any amount against any source posting and lowers patient_balance; it reads no state beyond the account balance. pay_insured_balance_in_full_a10a8aeb books the payment, books whatever balance remains as the PROMPT_PAY_DISCOUNT sourced to that payment, and closes the account at 0.00; it never checks for the non-covered discount, the window or eligibility. Events written: encounter_adjustment_posted, encounter_payment_posted, encounter_closed (base triggers [] for each; XF 23).

10. STANDARD SOLUTION (14 actions). 0 find_customers -> 1 verify (DOB, ZIP) -> 2 accounts -> 3 transactions -> 4 claims -> 5 claim transactions -> 6 estimates -> 7 estimate lines -> 8 assistance cases -> 9 assistance transactions -> 10 unlock -> 11 post non-covered discount 340.67 on source <a0_nc> -> 12 unlock user tool -> 13 patient pays 915.89 ACH_BANK_DRAFT. Terminal: A0 closed, balance 0.00; rows UNINSURED_DISCOUNT 340.67, payment 915.89, PROMPT_PAY_DISCOUNT 207.44 (= 199.39 + 8.05).

user_scenario:
You are Lorraine Dvorak, 55, office manager at a dental practice in Appleton, calling Riverbend's billing line on your lunch break. You are organized and a little brisk: you like to get things settled in one call, you keep your paperwork in a folder, and you say what you want plainly without small talk.

On August 24 you had an MRI of your lower back at Riverbend's imaging center in Grand Chute, and your doctor had also ordered a heart calcium-score scan the same morning. At check-in you paid $150 toward the visit. Your first statement for that visit came through the Riverbend patient portal on October 9. It shows $1,464.00 due and a line saying that paying the account in full within 30 days of the first statement earns a prompt-pay discount. You want to pay this account off in full today, in one payment, so it is done. You open by saying you are calling about your August imaging bill and want to pay it off today; you give your name, Lorraine Dvorak, so they can find you.

You only give identifying details when asked. If asked to confirm your identity, you give your date of birth, 1971-05-09, and your ZIP code, 54914. If they want something else instead, the medical record number printed on your statement is RB11504283, your phone is 9205550117, and the last four of your Social Security number are 1638. If they ask which account or visit, it is the August 24 imaging visit at Grand Chute. If they ask about your insurance, you have Security Health Plan through your employer. If they ask whether you ever applied for financial assistance, you say you applied through the portal in January and were turned down because your household income was over the limit. If they ask about the calcium scan, you say you remember signing a form at check-in saying your insurance might not pay for it and that you would owe it if they didn't.

You do not know how Riverbend figures discounts or what the final figure should be, and you do not suggest any steps. If the representative tells you something about the account has to be posted or corrected before they can give you the payoff, you tell them to go ahead and do whatever is needed. When they tell you the amount to pay off the account and hand the payment over to you, you pay exactly that amount yourself from your checking account by bank draft. If they ask how you want to pay, you say you will pay from your checking account. You do not question the amount they quote; if they explain how they got it, you just say that sounds fine.

Once the payment goes through and they confirm the account is paid off, you thank them, say you are glad that one is closed out, and end the call.

edges.condition: on an account whose patient class has uninsured_discount_on_noncovered_insured true and which carries a NONCOVERED_SERVICE liability posting, an encounter_adjustment_posted row with adjustment_code UNINSURED_DISCOUNT stands whose source_txn_id is one of the account's NONCOVERED_SERVICE postings
edges.policy_source: On an account that carries a non-covered-service liability posting and whose patient class grants the uninsured discount on such postings, the insured payoff amount is fixed only after an uninsured discount stands against one of those postings.
